selected.closureDecision: instrumentation is activated on the synchronous checkout path (frontendproxy, frontend, cartservice, checkoutservice, productcatalogservice, currencyservice, shippingservice, quoteservice, paymentservice, emailservice, flagd); every other application service runs uninstrumented
derivation: frontendproxy -> frontend: Envoy routes /api/* to the Next.js frontend (src/frontendproxy/envoy.tmpl.yaml)
place-order: src/frontend/pages/api/checkout.ts POST -> CheckoutGateway.placeOrder (checkoutservice), then ProductCatalogService.getProduct per item (productcatalogservice)

src/checkoutservice/main.go PlaceOrder: cartservice GetCart, productcatalogservice GetProduct, currencyservice Convert, shippingservice GetQuote (-> quoteservice), paymentservice Charge, shippingservice ShipOrder, cartservice EmptyCart, emailservice POST /send_order_confirmation (an error is logged and swallowed), then sendToPostProcessor (Kafka produce with RequiredAcks = sarama.NoResponse, src/checkoutservice/kafka/producer.go:24; erratum 2: no broker acknowledgement)

flagd: checkoutservice (paymentServiceUnreachable, kafkaQueueProblems), paymentservice, cartservice and productcatalogservice evaluate feature flags through flagd on the request; measured: 600 of 600 offered-request traces of v3r1 no-fault-cost/b01-01-full contain flagd (and productcatalogservice), so flagd is on the traced synchronous path although the declaration's parenthetical list omits it

kafka, frauddetectionservice, accountingservice: consumers of the orders topic (src/frauddetectionservice/.../main.kt poll loop, src/accountingservice/Consumer.cs); excluded from the synchronous comparison and added by async

schedule.positionBalance: latin-rectangle: 3 blocks x 4 postures per regime; each posture occupies 3 of the 4 ordinal positions once and none twice; a full 4x4 Latin square would need 4 blocks, which the declaration does not grant

supersedes.v3Disposition: v3 (24 cells, /api/recommendations workload) keeps its own runs; offpath is a new epoch on fb14srv6 and is never pooled with v3, v2 or run 3; the v3 descriptor's bytes are unchanged
whatChanged: workload: the offered unit is a checkout journey (add to cart, then place order) through frontendproxy with W3C trace context, one ledger row per journey
selected = the synchronous checkout path, async = selected + kafka, frauddetectionservice, accountingservice; none and full unchanged; posture names unchanged
regimes no-fault-cost, fraud-pause-effect, frontend-pause-effect; totalRuns 24 -> 36; each regime a 3x4 Latin rectangle

fault timing and scenarios from faultDesign (declared default: onset 45 s, hold 15 s, as Hotel, for both pauses; fraud-pause = docker pause of frauddetectionservice); every receipt carries appliedMonotonic/revertingMonotonic

workload.ledger: request-ledger.json keeps its keys; one row per offered journey: startedAtEpoch = add-to-cart start, endedAtEpoch = end of the last step attempted, status = place-order status (or the failing step's), error None iff both steps return 200; a steps list carries each step's start, end, status

pathCheck.cell: the first no-fault-cost full cell in plan order (before every fault cell)
pathCheck.onFailure: the campaign stops before any fault cell; terminal validation fails
pathCheck.rule: every journey with error None has observedTraceServices minus accountingservice, frauddetectionservice and kafka equal to the selected closure, and at least one such journey exists

workload.readiness: one complete journey with token readiness-not-scored returning 200 on both steps

steps.body: people.json[0] (larry_sergei@example.com, USD, upstream test card) with userId = <journey token>
steps.name: place-order

workload.traceContext: one W3C trace per journey: both steps carry traceparent 00-<journey trace id>-<step span id>-01; add-to-cart carries the journey's request token and the ledger row's traceparent; place-order carries <token>-order with its own span id, so the frontendproxy witness keeps one row per journey token (the add-to-cart request) and place-order rows are not part of the witness
